policy.physicalCreation: Create the Africa continent and region indexes first. Country parents and child repositories remain planned until maintainers and datasets are ready.
policy.ownerRequirement: Create repositories only while authenticated as the target owner or an organization admin. Do not let GitHub CLI fall back to the current personal account.
policy.noRawAddress: Do not store raw personal addresses, recipient records, private coordinates, witness data, or private keys in public repositories.
policy.postalWeakness: Many Africa country packs must support postal-code-weak, postal-code-absent, informal settlement, rural, nomadic, island, desert, and humanitarian delivery modes.
policy.disputedBoundary: Treat disputed, de facto, or special regions as technical address identifiers with explicit display policy, not as political recognition.
policy.heavyData: Keep building polygons, coordinates, search indexes, tiles, OSM/Overture extracts, humanitarian datasets, hydrographic data, and generated caches in external content-addressed packs.

repositories.creationRationale: The continent index can be completed with safe coordination metadata before any country dataset is published.
repositories.description: AGID Africa index for Northern, Western, Eastern, Southern, and Central Africa, postal-weak countries, no-postal-code areas, territories, and staged country packs.

repositories.creationRationale: Region indexes can publish repository pointers, source policy, postal status, conformance status, and no-raw rules without raw address data.
repositories.description: AGID Northern Africa index for Africa country and territory repository coordination.

repositories.creationRationale: Country and territory parents wait for maintainers, source licenses, postal policy, address hierarchy rules, quality gates, and no-raw checks.
